description: Six attack-and-decay envelope generators, each able to hold at its peak while a gate is high and each able to free-run as a looping shape

params.text: Sets that channel's attack time, 1.5ms to 1.5 seconds
Sets that channel's decay time, 1.5ms to 1.5 seconds
Switched to the gate symbol that channel holds at its peak for as long as the gate stays high, then decays; switched to the pulse symbol it runs attack then decay whatever the gate does
Switched to the loop symbol that channel free-runs, rising and falling over and over without a gate; switched back it runs only on a gate

inputs.text: A rising edge starts that channel's envelope; leave it unpatched and the channel follows whatever reached the gate input above it

outputs.text: That channel's envelope, 0V to 8V when it runs once and -8V to +8V when it loops

notes: the six gate inputs cascade: a channel with nothing patched reads the channel above it, and channel 1 with nothing patched reads 0V. Patch one gate and every channel below it follows.
a channel set to loop runs on its own and ignores the gate input except as a reset; a channel set to one shot does nothing until a gate arrives.
a looping channel swings both sides of zero, from -8V to +8V, while a one-shot channel runs from 0V to 8V.
